title: Great African Museum Initiative
desc: The African Union's Great African Museum Initiative is a high-profile Agenda 2063 flagship designed to elevate African cultural heritage and creative artifacts globally. This non-procurement strategic opening allows TM Foundation and Takeout Media to jointly position for underlying ecosystem intelligence and pan-African communications work.
recommendation: Initiate a proactive BD outreach campaign targeting AU cultural division leads with a co-authored concept note on heritage storytelling and creative economy intelligence.
partners: African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) Secretariat

title: Google Arts & Culture Initiatives
desc: Google Arts & Culture collaborates with institutions globally to preserve and amplify cultural heritage through technology. TM Foundation can leverage its creator economy intelligence and TMCON platform to build a long-term strategic partnership focused on African digital creators and cultural documentation.
recommendation: Pitch Google Arts & Culture on a collaborative research and digital showcase initiative spotlighting African creator economy data and digital cultural preservation.
partners: National Council for Arts and Culture (Nigeria)

title: Great African Museum Initiative (Advisory Track)
desc: The Great African Museum Initiative is an African Union Agenda 2063 flagship project focused on preserving and promoting continental cultural heritage and dynamic arts. TM Foundation can leverage its creative economy intelligence and research credentials to proactively secure a strategic advisory role with the AU Commission.
recommendation: Engage the African Union Commission Division of Culture with a strategic concept note on integrating creative economy intelligence into the initiative.
partners: AU Commission Social Development, Culture and Sports

title: Google News Initiative (GNI)
desc: The Google News Initiative offers continuous funding and resources to strengthen independent media and content creators. TM Foundation is well-positioned to proactively partner with GNI by linking its research and CIRP framework to Google's publisher sustainability goals in Africa.
recommendation: Initiate proactive outreach to Google's Sub-Saharan Africa media lead to present CIRP and research credentials for programmatic alignment.

title: The WIPO Scale Up Your IP Program 2026 for Women Innovators
desc: WIPO has launched the Scale Up Your IP Program 2026 to assist African women innovators and creators in protecting and commercializing their IP assets. TM Foundation can leverage this opportunity as a strategic partnership to embed IP commercialization into CIRP and strengthen institutional ties with WIPO.
recommendation: Initiate outreach to WIPO's Africa Regional Division to propose TM Foundation as an ecosystem delivery and pipeline partner for IP commercialization modules.
partners: African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) Secretariat

title: Encyclopaedia Africana Project
desc: The African Union's Encyclopaedia Africana Project is a flagship Agenda 2063 initiative to document authentic African history, culture, and creative heritage. TM Foundation and Takeout Media can proactively engage AU leadership to position themselves as primary intelligence, digital media, and content curation partners.
recommendation: Develop and submit a proactive concept paper proposing a creator-led digital archiving and multimedia campaign framework for the Encyclopaedia Africana.

title: Global Institute Fellowship for Transforming Systems 2026
desc: The Global Institute Fellowship for Transforming Systems 2026 targets leaders driving sector-wide transformation and institutional innovation globally. It presents an opportunity for TM Foundation leadership to strengthen international networks and amplify its creative economy research and ecosystem agenda.
recommendation: Track full application guidelines and submission deadlines to evaluate nominating executive leadership.

title: Google.org AI Collaboratives
desc: Google.org's AI Collaboratives program supports cross-sector partnerships deploying artificial intelligence for high-impact societal challenges globally. TM Foundation can proactively leverage its intelligence credentials to position African creative industry AI readiness as a vital research and policy frontier.
recommendation: Develop and submit a proactive concept note to Google.org Africa leads framing AI readiness and impact research within the African creative economy.
